description: Use when someone wants to buy a puppy from a reputable breeder in Germany, e.g. 'find a Labrador breeder in Bavaria' or 'seriöser Züchter Golden Retriever Bayern'. Searches HonestDog's directory of vetted, APPROVED dog breeders, optionally by breed (slug from search_breeds) and German state or city. Returns public profile data + the honestdog.de profile URL — contact happens there, never through this tool. For Qualzucht breeds this returns a caution instead of results. / Für 'Welpen vom seriösen Züchter kaufen': durchsucht das Verzeichnis geprüfter Züchter (nur freigegebene Profile, öffentliche Daten).

breed_slug.description: Restrict to breeders of this breed (slug from search_breeds)
